values.description: Hex secret used to sign Curis → SMART events. Must match operators.smart_outbound_secret in Curis. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Hex secret SMART signs claims with. Must match operators.smart_webhook_secret in Curis. Set in simulator .env as CURIS_INBOUND_SECRET — the simulator does the signing, Postman doesn't need it directly.
